notes.title: Latest from New Reality Games, State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem
notes.content:
The sequel to State of Anarchy is here! 
we've reached the day of release and now the time to annihilate aliens is nigh, Huzzah!
Pick up State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem now whilst it's on discount by clicking on the link below and please leave a review if you have the time!
If you have any constructive criticism or problems, please let us know so we can work on addressing them at once!
Happy shooting,
--Oliver

notes.title: Just Released on Steam, Atonement 2: Ruptured by Despair
notes.content:
The brand new Atonement 2: Ruptured by despair has just been released! For those of you who loved the first game, here comes the sequel, with even more great gameplay, story and characters! 

The last king was killed over 400 years ago and the global rule of the land ceased to exist. The Vindicator is coming. ~a decadent, dark fantasy world with a new take on the concepts of Angels and Demons! 
Click the link below if your interested then hurry, buy the game with a 30% launch discount and whittle hours completing it! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/533820/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

If you haven't tried the first game and this sounds like your cup of tea, go check it out on the following link! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385070/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: The latest from New Reality Games
notes.content:
Help us greenlight our latest game; So Many Cubes!
So Many Cubes is a fun yet chaotic strategy game where the objective is to destroy the Mothercube.
There's plenty of fun to be had and we need your help to get the game greenlit so if you like this great game, just go over and help us by voting yes!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=735244089

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
The community spoke, and we listened! Latest changes as per recent feedback:

- Each unit and spell have now the same cooldown to improve balance if the game
- Enemy units reduced, so the difficulty of the game
